text.aria-label: Title text 'Averaging the 51 ENS members brings the ERA5-trained forecast's slope close to that of a forecast with no weather error; a single member's slope falls with lead'

g.text: Averaging the 51 ENS members brings the ERA5-trained forecast's slope close to that of a forecast with no weather error; a single member's slope falls with lead

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Slope of the best-fit line through observed power (y) against forecast power (x), both as a fraction of capacity. Below 1: the forecast's swings are larger than the swings that come true. At 1: on average, observed power equals the forecast at every forecast level. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds. Dashed line at 1. Grey: the ERA5-trained model given ERA5 weather at the valid time. Slope above 1: the forecast varies less than the outcomes.'
text.tspan: Slope of the best-fit line through observed power (y) against forecast power (x), both as a fraction of capacity. Below 1: the forecast's swings are larger than the swings that come true. At 1: on average, observed power equals the forecast at every forecast level.

ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
Dashed line at 1. Grey: the ERA5-trained model given ERA5 weather at the valid time. Slope above 1: the forecast varies less than the outcomes.
